BGEO.notes: TTM = 4Q25 (diluted EPS 13.62, basic 13.84; profit attributable 589.7) from the FY25 preliminary results RNS of 25 Feb 2026 (ticker.app full text) + 9M26 (diluted 43.38, basic 43.81; 1,865.7) from the 3Q26 release. Basic TTM EPS would be 57.65. Quarterly profit: 4Q25 589.7, 1Q26 585.0 (derived 1,865.7 - 618.8 - 661.9 = 585.0; matches secondary summaries), 2Q26 618.8, 3Q26 661.9. Company reports in GEL; dataset is in GBP/pence, so the script's source-vs-document check cannot run on like units (rough check: 2,455.4m GEL at about 3.49 GEL/GBP [AJ Bell conversion 941.7m GEL = 270.0m GBP] is about 704m GBP; dataset implies 5,855 / 8.61 = 680m GBP, within about 3.5%). ONE-OFFS: no one-off gain inside the last 12 months. The only company-labelled one-off in the window is a GEL 29.6m ESOP catch-up expense in 4Q25 (profit before one-offs 619.3 vs reported 589.7; the difference equals the full 29.6, so no tax effect was applied); frac = 29.6 / 2,455.4 = 0.0121. Not listed: GEL 5.8m goodwill impairment in 2Q26 (Other Businesses; 0.2% of TTM; not labelled one-off by the company). The big one-off gain (GEL 668.8m, mainly Ameriabank bargain purchase, 1Q24) is in FY2024 only - outside the TTM but inside the five-year history: FY24 reported profit 2,485.2 vs 1,813.0 before one-offs, so the source's 2024 ROE (41.3% nominal) and the FY25 EPS fall (basic 50.27 vs 56.91) are distorted by it; adjusted basic EPS FY25 50.96 vs FY24 41.46. Tax rate: 9M26 373.3 / 2,239.0 = 16.7%; FY25 417.2 / 2,580.5 = 16.2%. No absolute EPS guidance (medium-term targets only).

FOUR.notes: EPS is diluted, in US dollars (3.611); basic TTM would be 404.4 - 197.4 + 155.1 = 362.1c. The company reports half-yearly: TTM = FY2025 - H1 2025 + H1 2026, all three columns read in the H1 2026 interim announcement (company PDF, primary). No non-controlling interest, so profit for the period = attributable to shareholders. NO ONE-OFF GAINS found in the 12 months: FY2025 and H1 2025 had no adjusting items; no disposal, property or pension gains (pension remeasurement nil). H1 2026 has a one-off CHARGE (adjusting items, uncertain historical income tax treatments, 5.1m after tax = 5.0% of TTM profit), listed as offset. Finance income on cash deposits (3.1m reported in H1 2026, 3.4m in H1 2025) is recurring. Tax rate 25% is the company's adjusted effective rate for H1 2026 (reported: 16.1/59.6 = 27%). Guidance left empty: the company guides adjusted PROFIT BEFORE TAX of about 130m for FY2026, not EPS (rule: non-EPS measure is not used). For information only, my arithmetic, not a company figure: 130m x (1 - 0.25) = 97.5m adjusted profit, about 4% below the 101.6m TTM reported profit. Cross-check with the dataset: 4,096p / 15.22 = 269p; 361.1c x 0.7555 (meta fx) = 273p, within 2%.

MEGP.notes: EPS is in pence (price is in pence), net profit in million GBP. All three periods are printed in the company's interim results RNS of 13 Jul 2026 (H1 26, H1 25 and FY25 columns); FY25 figures also read in the annual results RNS of 23 Mar 2026. Basic TTM EPS would be 15.00 - 6.79 + 6.50 = 14.71p. Check against the source: 103p / 7.03 = 14.65p; 385.1m / 7.03 = 54.8m vs 55.52m (within 3%). No non-controlling interest: all profit is attributable to owners. Tax rate 25.0% is H1 2026 (8,183 / 32,722); FY2025 was 27.7% (provisions for French tax reassessments, amount not disclosed). ONE-OFFS BELOW THRESHOLD, not listed: net non-operating income was 550k in H1 2026 (of which a 541k fair-value gain on an FVTPL investment), about 0.7% of 12-month profit after 25% tax; FY2025 non-operating income was 2,211k in total, of which at least 1,595k (Grenoble building sale) fell in H1 2025, outside the 12 months, so at most about 0.6m sits in H2 2025; its composition is not disclosed. Together at most about 1.2m pre-tax, about 1.6% of profit. FY2025 also had a 1.2m loss on sale of PP&E. Guidance is profit before tax only (69-74m for FY2026), not EPS, so it is not entered; at a 25% tax rate it would imply roughly 51.8-55.5m after tax against 55.52m for the 12 months (my arithmetic, not a company figure).

SNWS.notes: Read in the 4 Nov 2026 preliminary results RNS (ticker.app full text): statutory PAT attributable to ordinary shareholders 24.4m (FY2025 28.3m); basic EPS 10.1p, diluted 9.7p (11.7p / 11.3p); PBT 32.1m, tax 7.7m, effective rate 24.0%; weighted shares 242.6m basic. H1 (interim RNS 6 May 2026): PAT 12.2m, basic EPS 5.0p; H2 by subtraction 12.2m and 5.1p. EPS is in pence, so eps_cur is GBX to match the price unit; net profit in million GBP. Source check: price 68p / P/E 7.0 = 9.7p, close to diluted EPS 9.7p and 4% BELOW basic 10.1p, so the source is not above the document. NO one-off gain inside the 12 months: the 3.7m McColl's impairment reversal is in FY2025, outside. One-off costs of 3.0m after tax are listed as offsets. JUDGMENT CALL for the main session: the World Cup collectables contribution ('record ... of over £3m', 29 Sep 2026 trading update; it is not clear whether this is profit or margin) is event-driven; I put it in drop as ordinary recurring business. If treated as a gain it would be about 2.3m after tax = 9% of profit, more than offset netting aside. No EPS guidance: FY2027 profit will be lower per the company (7-9m transition costs) but no figure is given, so the rule cannot lower earnings; this is said in the first risk.
